value.deck: Microsoft has released a new update for Visual Studio Code, the world's most popular tool for writing computer software.
shortVersion: Microsoft has officially launched version 1.134 of Visual Studio Code. This program is the world's most popular code editor, which is a digital workspace people use to write software. Millions of software creators rely on this program every single day to do their work.

The new update introduces several fresh features and overall improvements to the tool. These changes are part of a continuous effort to quickly update the software over time. Everyday users will see these helpful updates right in their daily work routines.
value.plainLanguage: A popular program that millions of people use to write computer software just received fresh features and updates.

keyTerms.meaning: A software program that acts like a specialized text document editor designed specifically for writing computer code.
An official public launch of a updated version of a software product.

value.whyItMatters: This release matters because millions of developers use this specific tool every day, so even small improvements make a big difference in how software gets built.
watchNext: Watch for future rapid updates as Microsoft continues to add new capabilities to the tool.
See how developers incorporate the new features and improvements into their daily work routines.
